acceptance: Each of the six notes is fixed with a regression test where behavior changes, or dismissed with a recorded reason.
Released in a Theseus version and locked by BenchBox and Theseus's self-lock.
description:
Independent reviews of recent Theseus PRs left non-blocking notes. Re-verify each on current main before acting; line numbers drift.
1. src/theseus_reviewer/layout.py:44: `_REFERENCE` only catches a reference label on one line. CommonMark allows a label to span lines, so a split `[label\n]: dest` passes through `neutralize` unchanged and can create a relative link. Impact is low because sanitizing already removes absolute URLs.
2. src/theseus_reviewer/suggestions.py:50: `target.is_symlink()` is checked after `.resolve()`, so it is always False and a symlinked file inside the workspace is read through to its target. The containment check still blocks escapes outside the workspace.
3. src/theseus_reviewer/dashboard.py:44: when one finding has several bot threads in the same cycle, `setdefault` links whichever comes first, which may be an older thread instead of the current one.
4. src/theseus_reviewer/check_run.py:39-40: annotation text is plain text, but `layout.neutralize` HTML-escapes it, so `<` and similar entities appear literally in check-run annotations.
5. `theseus infra rotate` repeats the environment guard that setup already applies (noted in review; confirm the duplication on main before changing it).
6. Wording: docs that say a deployment-branch policy is open when it "starts with a wildcard" understate the rule in infra/github_env.py `is_open_pattern`: any glob character in the first path segment, or an empty pattern, counts as open (for example `rel*/x`).
